title: Data Centre Growth Sparks Debate Ahead of US Midterms
excerpt: The rise of data centres creates growing environmental concerns as the US midterms approach, highlighted in new data.
body_html:
Data centres serve as the foundation of the modern digital landscape. However, their rapid expansion has brought increased scrutiny regarding their environmental consequences.

Ahead of the US midterms, discussions surrounding these facilities have intensified. A series of charts examines the growth of data centres and the rising worries linked to their environmental footprint.
